subject: a 17th-century Maratha king of the Deccan with a trimmed beard and moustache, wearing a tall Maratha-style turban with a pearl string, a long fitted angarkha coat with a sash, and a sheathed straight sword at his side, alert and composed

panels.01-shivneri: a basalt hill fort with stone gates and ramparts on top of a steep hill in the Sahyadri mountains of western India in 1630, monsoon clouds, terraced fields below, wide establishing shot, dignified and calm
panels.02-torna: a young {S} at about seventeen standing with a small band of Maratha soldiers in simple tunics and turbans at the gate of a high mountain fort at dawn in 1647, mist in the valleys below, determination
panels.03-pratapgad: {S} walking toward a large decorated tent pitched below a hill fort in a forested valley in 1659, guards and attendants waiting at a distance, tense moment before a meeting, no violence shown
panels.04-sindhudurg: {S} standing on a rocky island off the Konkan coast in 1664, watching workers lay great stone blocks for a sea fort wall, wooden sailing boats in the bay, sea spray, golden light
panels.05-agra: {S} and a young boy quietly leaving a Mughal mansion at night in 1666, red sandstone walls and arches, a lantern, guards in the distance, suspense and resolve
panels.06-coronation: {S} seated on a raised throne under a royal parasol in a stone hall of Raigad fort in 1674, Brahmin priests performing the coronation ritual, ministers and officers standing in rows, garlands, solemn and grand
panels.07-gingee: {S} on horseback at the head of Maratha cavalry looking up at the great granite hills and walls of Gingee fort in southern India in 1677, dust and sunshine, a long campaign
panels.08-raigad: the wide plateau of Raigad fort at sunset in 1680, an octagonal stone memorial and old stone walls, soldiers and ministers standing in respectful silence, mountains fading into the distance, dignified farewell
